instruccion: Read the text or image of a Spanish invoice and extract the data in the indicated format. If a piece of data does not appear, put null, do not invent it.
contexto: The user is a freelancer (autónomo) or small business and wants to keep a record of their expense or sales invoices without using accounting software.

esquema_salida.tipo_factura: sale or expense, depending on who issues it
avisos: list of short texts if any mandatory data is missing or something looks odd

reglas: Do not invent tax IDs (NIF), dates, or amounts that are not in the original text.
If the total does not match the sum of base plus VAT minus withholding, say so in avisos instead of correcting it yourself.
If the invoice has no number or is missing mandatory data, say so in avisos; do not treat it as valid.
Amounts are always in euros with a decimal point, without a currency symbol.
no_hacer: Do not calculate taxes that are not reflected in the original invoice.
Do not assume the VAT rate if it is not written: put null and flag it.
Do not use this result as a final tax return without human review.
